system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide

Often used in high-security areas or in places where security is more important than the preservation of the structure, Laser Trip Mines use a nearly invisible laser beam that acts as a tripwire to detonate the Mine. A Laser Trip Mine is placed on the ground (In any square adjacent to you) or against any other solid surface; you then designate a single solid surface within 6 squares as the laser's terminus. The Laser Trip Mine is triggered when any character, creature, Droid, or Vehicle enters a square that is part of the line between the square where the Laser Trip Mine is placed and the square that is the laser's terminus.

A Laser Trip Mine damages everything in a 2-square Burst radius.
